
│ Which rooms should be booked for Friday? (Pick any; only the hall is
│ booked now, and it was full both times it was tried)

❯ 1. [ ] The library (Recommended)
         Quiet and close to the kitchen, so the tea arrives hot. It has
         twelve chairs and a long table; the projector needs a cable
         brought from the office, which somebody has to remember.
  2. [ ] The garden room
         Light all afternoon, and the doors open onto the lawn when it is
         dry. It is cold before noon from October on.
  3. [ ] The attic
         Nobody else wants it, so it is always free. The stairs are steep
         and the ceiling is low at the far end; good for six, not for ten.
  4. [ ] None of these
         Keep the hall only, and move the meeting if it is full again.
